Research areas


Probability
Limit theorems, concentration phenomena, and probabilistic structures arising in mathematical models.


Stochastic Processes
Continuous-time Markov processes, metastability, and the long-time behavior of interacting systems.


Large Deviations
Variational principles, Gibbs measures, and asymptotic estimates for rare events.
